parsed.refutation_attempt: Verified that the code does not construct or invoke any OS command based on the untrusted input N. The function allocateSharedMatrix calls shmget, a system call that creates a shared memory segment; no command string is built or executed. The value N is only used in a size calculation for the shared memory allocation. The code checks for an error from shmget (shmid < 0) and exits, so even an attacker‑supplied large or negative N cannot lead to command execution or injection. The alleged sink is therefore a false positive for OS command injection.
